snippet.title: s t r a t O - v1.0.3
snippet.description:
This is a game I've made for Android, BlackBerry (and once I have generic gamepad/keyboard support, for PC)

Although it's stable and pretty enough to be sold, I'm still adding/extending it.

BLACKBERRY: ($1, no ads)
http://appworld.blackberry.com/webstore/content/59697320/

ANDROID:
Free (ad banner supported):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lemec.Strato

$1.00 (no ads) version:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lemec.StratoPro

If I make $100 from mobile sales, I'll be able to put it up a PC version for Steam Greenlight!
